description:
AnalyzeActivation reads a callee's ReturnType as it currently stands and is subscribed to every revision, so a caller outside any cycle with its callee re-runs on every rung of the callee's ascent. It also publishes its own return while some call sites still wait, so a return built from a subset of call sites rises again for each late piece of evidence. On fz-afu.13: main/0 runs 36 times in json_roundtrip, 45 in 00420_enum_take_drop_split, 22 in return_tuple_ladder, and 19 in `main() do a(3); :done end` where a's return climbs 17 revisions. No callee of json's main/0 has a return-dependency path back to it (independent audit, 2026-10-04).

Proposal page: ../fz-afu.4.html ("Concluded callee returns"). Probe: scratch afu4/probe_v2.patch (sketch only; variant B = PROBE_WITHHOLD=1 PROBE_NOREBASE=1). Hand answers: afu4/paper.md. Base is fz-afu.13 + fz-uyt (6c99b476f).

Design (variant B, approved 2026-10-04):
1. A callee return is read through World::answer_use: Partner (the reader itself, or a producer that waits on it) reads current and climbs with it; Concluded reads once; otherwise wait.
2. Unknown is not bottom. A call whose keying facts or return are waited for yields an unknown; the walk continues past it. Values computed from an unknown are unknown (body::step_used_values / step_defined_values); a call site with an unknown argument or callee publishes its edge unresolved; a dispatch on an unknown stops. Bottom (a partner's return not yet risen, or a concluded absent return) still ends the path.
3. An unknown absorbs the return: if any reachable path's result is unknown, the run publishes no new ReturnType and the previous value stands. A function publishes its return once per new evidence, never from a subset of call sites while others wait.
4. A protocol call asks for returns only once every target's prerequisites hold (otherwise a blocked run seeds an activation through SeedActivation: 00274, 00426, 00428).
5. pop_runnable keeps fz-afu.13's single runnability check and adds: concluded_answers_missing also checks the job's standing waits (00181 List.reduce/3). The earlier "a rebased job always runs" bypass is not added; fz-afu.13 absorbed it.

Removals: the unconditional reads.push(ReturnType) in prepare_function_call and its "chaotic iteration needs no wait" comment; `let Some(return_ty) = return_ty else { return Ok(None) }` in LoweredTail::DirectCall / ClosureCall (replaced by a three-way call return Known / Awaited / Bottom); the "partial evidence publishes safely" behaviour in analyze_activation; the parallel reads/waits collections plus current_uses (one use collector shared with ForwardingWalk in keying.rs; CalleeAnswers in runtime_demand.rs is a fold candidate).

A chain of d dependent calls costs 2d+1 analyses of the caller: a call into a callee whose keying facts are not derived costs a run before its activation can be minted.

Acceptance (variant B probe, measured):
- main/0 analyses: ladder 22 -> 5 (return revisions 2 -> 1), 00420 45 -> 5, p1 11 -> 5, json 36 -> 5, a(3) 19 -> 3; 2/4/8 independent callees 5/9/17 -> 3/3/3; Kernel.dbg/1 in the ladder 35 -> 3. These become pinned tests in a sibling _test.rs, through the production drive.
- s3 val/1 revisions 3 -> 1, item/2 activations 2 -> 1; p1 mints 2 Enum.reduce/3 activations.
- Jobs: ladder 272 -> 208, 00420 2688 -> 2466, p1 602 -> 591, s3 192 -> 171, s1 243 -> 202, json 2569 -> 2429, 1+2 144.
- Census 178,926 -> 171,748, widened returns 261 -> 1, outputs and exit codes identical; canon(BackendProgram) identical to base for json, s3, p1 and the ladder.
- Pins: drops as measured (json RETURN_LADDERS none, 00567 Activation claims 74 -> 66, 00571 cold walks 477 -> 475, work_start census 2688 -> 2466, fz2_cli aggregate 1235 -> 1231). Authorized: TUPLE_LADDER_BUILD_ANALYSES 19 -> 20 (withholding starts build's climb one run later); 00567 DeriveCallGraphComponent 61/19 -> 64/22 (fz-afu.8's per-level walk); 00181 FormulaWork wakes 180 -> 182, blocked 59 -> 72 (evaluations stay 276). 00567 reached_leaf_edit stays 9.
- Authorized census rises (2026-10-06), 35 fixtures in five classes: waiting for an absent return to conclude (+1: 00349, 00350, 00475, protocol_without_impl); chains gated on conclusions (00466 and others, e.g. fib_tailrec Kernel.+/2 3 -> 5 runs); sibling activations meeting prerequisites together (dispatch_list_head_separates +15); work past a call that never returns (opaque_fn_all_divergent +13, 00188 +7; final program unchanged); and closure_capture_requirement_projection +28, which is fz-afu.15's readiness churn (a late claimant unsettles a settled cone; see its description). Class 4 (protocol prerequisites) must not appear.

comments.text: Deep causal audit on fz-uyt/pin-toolchain 6c99b476f: json_roundtrip main/0 has exactly 36 balanced starts/completions: 1 initial + 3 InputDemand wakes (decode, dbg, roundtrip) + 7 Json.decode ReturnType wakes + 7 dbg ReturnType wakes + 8 encode! ReturnType wakes + 10 roundtrip ReturnType wakes. Every rerun has exactly one enqueued wake between its preceding completion and its start; 6 additional wakes coalesce. All uses are Current. Only 4 runs record waits; 32 are wait-free even though callee evidence is unfinished. main ReturnType stays revision 0 through run 34, becomes false on run 35, then false|true on run 36. Union of ALL AnalyzeActivation ReturnType read edges across trace: 27 direct main dependencies, 276 transitive dependencies, zero path back to main; main is not in a semantic return fixpoint with its callees. prepare_function_call at semantic.rs:1990 unconditionally subscribes Current and does not call answer_use; pop_runnable protects only prior Concluded reads. analyze_tail at semantic.rs:861 stops the continuation on absent return evidence, so unknown stalls discovery of independent later calls. Reduced probes: leaf main 1 run; one literal-returning callee then :done gives main 3 runs; 2/4/8 independent zero-arg literal-returning callees give main 5/9/17 runs, each callee once. Recursive probe main: a(3); :done, a(0)->:end, a(n)->{n,a(n-1)}: main 19 runs, one InputDemand wake + 17 return revisions from a; main is :done from run 3 onward and unchanged on the remaining 16 runs. Seven historical dbg activation keys read earlier in JSON are absent from main final return-read set (6 decode approximants + false-only roundtrip result), showing provisional evidence creates extra work, not just retries. This supports the existing concluded-outside-partners + explicit unknown design. It does not prove exactly one total AnalyzeActivation evaluation: this job currently must first discover/claim callee activations and their input evidence, and nested result-dependent calls require staged discovery. A global Settled wait is stronger than Concluded and can introduce ownership cycles; preserve the existing readiness distinction. No compiler code changed.

title: A caller reads each callee's return once it concludes, walks past pending calls as unknown, and withholds a partial return
